# @heswell/trading-test-data API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/api-reference.ts from the TypeScript source. Do not edit: run `bun run docs:api`. -->

The in-browser EXCHANGE + OMS (the real exchange-sim and OMS engines on `@heswell/vuu-data-engine-local`) behind the showcase, the tests and the engine-local mode of [getting started](../getting-started.md#2-engine-local-mode-no-servers). [Package README](../../packages/trading-test-data/README.md).

Imports: `@heswell/trading-test-data`, `@heswell/trading-test-data/react`. 18 exports. Types are shown as written in the source; defaults come from `@default` tags or the component's destructuring defaults.

### Interfaces (createTradingTestData)

#### TradingTestData

*interface* · [createTradingTestData.ts](../../packages/trading-test-data/src/createTradingTestData.ts#L101)

| Member | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `exchange` | `TradingLocalModule<ExchangeTableName>` |  |  |
| `oms` | `TradingLocalModule<OmsLocalTableName>` |  |  |
| `engine` | `LocalEngine` |  | The isolated engine both modules are registered with. |
| `sim` | `ExchangeSimulator` |  |  |
| `omsService` | `OmsService` |  |  |
| `schemas` | `Record<TradingLocalTableName, TableSchema>` |  | TableSchemas (identical to the server's TABLE_META_RESP), by table name. |
| `clock?` | `ManualClock` |  | Present when created with `manualClock`. |
| `running` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `start` | `() => void` |  | Start the exchange step/flush and OMS flow/mark timers. |
| `stop` | `() => void` |  |  |
| `advance` | `(ms: number) => void` |  | Deterministic time step (manual clock only): advances the clock in `botStepMs` slices, stepping the exchange and the OMS flow, then publishes and marks positions. |
| `rpc` | `(rpcName: RpcName, params: object, user?: TradingUser) => RpcResult` |  | Invoke an RPC directly, as `user` (default: engine-local current user), exactly as a viewport RPC would be handled. |
| `dispose` | `() => void` |  | Stop timers and dispose the sim, the OMS and the local engine. |

#### TradingTestDataOptions

*interface* · [createTradingTestData.ts](../../packages/trading-test-data/src/createTradingTestData.ts#L78)

| Member | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `seed?` | `number` |  | Seed for both the exchange simulator and the OMS background flow. The same seed (with a manual clock) reproduces the same market and orders. |
| `exchange?` | `Partial<ExchangeSimConfig>` |  | Exchange-sim overrides (see packages/exchange-sim/README.md). |
| `oms?` | `Partial<OmsConfig>` |  | OMS overrides (see packages/oms/README.md), e.g. `{ flowRate: 0 }`. |
| `manualClock?` | `boolean \| ManualClock` |  | When set, time only advances through `advance(ms)`: no timers run and the data is fully deterministic. Pass `true` or your own ManualClock. |
| `autoStart?` | `boolean \| "on-subscribe"` |  | When the sim/OMS timers start: `"on-subscribe"` (default) when the first data source is created, `true` immediately, `false` only via `start()`. Ignored (always false) with a manual clock. |

## localServer

### Functions (localServer)

#### getTradingTestData

*function* · [localServer.ts](../../packages/trading-test-data/src/localServer.ts#L16)

The shared in-browser trading data (created on first use). Options only
apply to the call that creates it; use resetTradingTestData to recreate.

```ts
getTradingTestData(options?: TradingTestDataOptions): TradingTestData
```

#### resetTradingTestData

*function* · [localServer.ts](../../packages/trading-test-data/src/localServer.ts#L25)

Disposes the shared in-browser trading data and recreates it with `options`
(tests, showcase reset).

```ts
resetTradingTestData(options?: TradingTestDataOptions): TradingTestData
```

## modules

### Functions (modules)

#### visualLinksFor

*function* · [modules/visualLinks.ts](../../packages/trading-test-data/src/modules/visualLinks.ts#L9)

Visual links declared on the trading-schemas table definitions, restricted
to parent tables published by the same module (engine-local links are
module scoped, as on the Vuu server).

```ts
visualLinksFor<T extends string>(defs: Partial<Record<T, TableDefinition>>, moduleTables: readonly T[]): Record<T, VuuLink[] | undefined>
```

### Classes (modules)

#### TradingLocalModule

*class* · [modules/TradingLocalModule.ts](../../packages/trading-test-data/src/modules/TradingLocalModule.ts#L33)

A config-driven engine-local VuuModule. Register it with a LocalEngine
(createTradingTestData does).

Extends `VuuModule<T>`.

```ts
new TradingLocalModule(config: TradingLocalModuleConfig<T>)
```

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `getTable(tableName: T)` | Table by name (the engine-local wrapper; `.engineTable` for raw access). |
| `userForViewport(viewportId: string)` | The user that owns a viewport (falls back to the current user). |

## react

### Functions (react)

#### createTradingLocalServer

*function* · [react.ts](../../packages/trading-test-data/src/react.ts#L16)

A LocalVuuServer publishing the EXCHANGE and OMS modules: pass it to a
local-mode AuthenticationProvider (`localServers`) or render its
DataSourceProvider directly (as TradingDataProvider mode="local" does).

```ts
createTradingLocalServer(testData: TradingTestData = getTradingTestData(), connectionId = TRADING_LOCAL_CONNECTION_ID): LocalVuuServer
```
